headlines.title: Sen. Darline Graham and Rep. Ralph Norman advance to GOP Senate primary runoff in South Carolina
headlines.description: Graham, the sister of the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, will face another Republican in an Aug. 25 runoff for the party’s nomination, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Trump took a secret flight out of Turkey in an elaborate plot to hide his location amid the Iran war
headlines.description: The operation last month used a catering truck to get the president on the C-32 that flew from Ankara to Royal Air Force Mildenhall in the U.K.

headlines.title: Democratic Rep. John Larson loses his primary to opponent calling for generational change
headlines.description: The 14-term Connecticut Democrat lost to former Hartford Mayor Luke Bronin in a heavily blue district, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Norman, Graham advance to South Carolina GOP Senate runoff
headlines.description: Rep. Ralph Norman will face Sen. Darline Graham in the Republican Senate primary runoff in South Carolina, NBC News projects. The election will be held August 25. NBC News’ Steve Kornacki and Ryan Nobles report.

headlines.title: Sen. Darline Graham advances to runoff in S.C. GOP Senate primary
headlines.description: After being appointed to her late brother Lindsey Graham’s Senate seat in July, Sen. Darline Graham has advanced to a Republican primary runoff in South Carolina, NBC News projects. NBC News’ Steve Kornacki breaks down the vote totals.

headlines.title: Secret Service operation to swap Trump’s planes amid Iran threat
headlines.description: We are learning new details about the elaborate Secret Service operation to swap President Trump’s planes amid an Iranian assassination threat. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Trump’s ICE crackdown returns to the spotlight as the midterms loom: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Natasha Korecki digs into the perilous immigration politics facing the Trump administration and the GOP. Plus, we preview the key races to watch as primary results roll in this evening.

headlines.title: Judge finds Kennedy Center owes musician $250,000 in legal fees
headlines.description: A judge in Washington, D.C., dismissed the center’s suit against Chuck Redd for canceling a concert after the president’s name was added to the facade.

headlines.title: Lauren Boebert’s 21-year-old son is arrested on child sexual exploitation charges
headlines.description: The allegations are linked to a video Tyler Boebert, then 18, is accused of recording in 2024 with a 17-year-old.

headlines.title: Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs chooses former Republican as running mate in re-election bid
headlines.description: Hobbs faces a competitive re-election race against GOP Rep. Andy Biggs, former chair of the House Freedom Caucus.

headlines.title: Jennifer Balkcom picked to replace Rep. Chuck Edwards in N.C. congressional race
headlines.description: Edwards dropped his re-election bid after the House Ethics Committee recommended he be censured over sexual harassment allegations. He has denied any wrongdoing.
